rubric_notes: Complete: superfamily a.22.1 (47113), families 47114/47129/47134/101318 with correct members; bacterial duplication and Thermus H3-H4-tetramer-like assembly annotation supported by bundle; fold core comment supported; shared superfamily = probable common ancestry, fold/class insufficient; linker histone a.4.5.13 separation with caveat that it is not proof of independent origin; oligomeric/DNA-binding/template transfer rejected. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

All identifiers and annotations match evidence. Correct superfamily-level homology inference, family divergence, rejection of HisE/MazG function transfer, and additionally notes SCOPe records do not supply the underlying alignment/literature argument and that inference applies to domains not whole proteins. Complete.

Correct families with SUNIDs 53068/53083/53089 under c.55.1 (53067), fold c.55, class c; all supported. Duplication comment supported by annotations endpoint. Infers probable common ancestry of catalytic cores, rejects fold/class as sufficient for homology (supported by fold homology warning), gives a sound evolutionary diversification interpretation, and rejects transfer of polymerization, chaperone activity, substrate specificity, reaction chemistry, and templates. Names external evidence required. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Correct family/superfamily/fold identifiers with stable release 2.08 (stable label supported by the releases/current endpoint); fold-core and bimetal annotations supported. States superfamily is the positive evolutionary assertion while fold/class give only structural similarity; explicitly says different reactions neither contradict homology nor establish convergence. Rejects transfer of iron storage, radical chemistry, catalase activity, metal preference, substrate, oligomeric organization, and template use; requires alignments, residue correspondence, metal/ligand-bound structures, assays, partner context, and phylogenetic/literature support, and states these were not inspected. Scopes the RNR relationship to the classified R2 domain. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete hierarchy with SUNIDs verified against bundle (sccs/b.6.1.5 and b.6.1.6 parents chains). Superfamily supports evolutionary relationship; fold/class only structural; not one family. Quotes superfamily and family annotations correctly and uses specific annotations to qualify the general one. Requires coordinating residues/geometry, metal-binding/spectroscopic evidence, and redox partners; notes these were not examined. PAD4 domain vs whole-enzyme caveat. No violations.

All three families with correct SCCS and SUNIDs placed in d.15.1 (54236), fold d.15 (54235), class a+b, release 2.08; matches bundle. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct identifiers, siblings, fold comment, and PubMed 19893485 all supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

No unmet criteria. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and well-supported. 1.69 and 2.08 hierarchies correct; current SID d1t1ja1 A:1-118 with retained SUNID 106249 supported by pdb/1t1j/domains; periodic update label 2.08-2026-08-16 supported by /releases/current. All required elements present and correct: synthetic tag H:1-8 SUNID 343393, class l Artifacts, l.1.1.1 Tags; d1a14h1 H:9-111 SUNID 20061 VH b.1.1.1; tag similarity should not support common ancestry, function transfer, or template selection. Correct 1.75 whole-chain placement with the four structural domain spans from the fold comment, correct 2.08 pair with SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, families, superfamilies, folds, and the class b move. Reasoning is complete: the classified unit need not equal the chain or every compact subdomain, the C-terminal unit retains three structural domains, different superfamilies assert neither homology nor independent origin, and a PA14 match cannot confer whole-chain homology, protective-antigen function, or C-terminal template suitability. Searches are correctly scoped to the two regions with coverage assessment and explicit release-and-residue remapping. Only the first release of the split, 2.04, is missing and is explicitly disclaimed.

Complete and correct five-domain listing with boundaries and SCCS; new fold d.394 at residues 47-697; family annotations cited are in bundle; mosaic recruitment interpretation with homology-level and function-transfer caveats. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Makes the required inference cleanly: shared family a.298.1.1 with domain SUNIDs, differing numbers of repeating units as the explanation, and the 'single repeat' comment, 're' annotations, and non-transferable representative repeat as the annotation evidence against separate ancestry. Correct homology scoping and strong rejection of specificity, activity, template, and quality-ranking transfer. Factual support falls one step because the actual domain lengths underlying the prompt are not given; the answer says the retrieved records did not establish them instead of fabricating numbers.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Both convergence and divergence explained, with limit that SCOPe placement alone proves neither independent origin nor remote homology. Contrasts the ten-stranded CUB-like description with the nine-stranded b.18 jelly roll, flags the calcium-free strand caveat as a conformational confound rather than curatorial rationale, and treats the PubMed 17977833 comment as a literature pointer, not an inspected 1nqd-1dlc alignment. Blocks collagen, collagenase, galactose, receptor, and template transfer.
